rules.keyword: hello, hi, hey, good morning, good afternoon, good evening
responses: How can I help you today? Ask me any questions about admission, fees, or screening, or type *.menu* for commands.

rules.keyword: school fees, tuition, fees, acceptance fee, pay fees
responses:
📌 *EKSU Payment Information:*
All acceptance fees and school fees must be paid directly on the official student portal:
🔗 https://eksuportal.eksu.edu.ng/app_signin.php
⚠️ *Critical Warning:* Never pay school fees into personal individual accounts or to anyone claiming to be an agent. Always print your official e-receipt immediately after payment.

rules.keyword: jamb caps, caps, aip, admission in progress, accept admission
responses:
🎓 *JAMB CAPS Guide:*
1. Check your status at: https://efacility.jamb.gov.ng/Login
2. If status is *Admission in Progress (AIP)* or *Recommended*, it is NOT final yet. Do not pay any fees at this stage.

📱 To accept via SMS, send:
*[JAMB_REG_NUMBER] ACCEPT* to *55019* (or 66019) from your linked SIM card.
